claims: Robert Mueller died on Friday night, March 20, 2026.
Robert Mueller died in Charlottesville, Virginia.
The cause of Robert Mueller's death was Parkinson’s disease.
Robert Mueller's family confirmed his death.
Robert Mueller was diagnosed with Parkinson’s disease in 2021.
Robert Mueller had been living in a senior living facility in Virginia following his retirement.
Robert Mueller served as FBI director from 2001 to 2013.
Robert Mueller led the investigation into Russian interference in the 2016 U.S. election.
